creators.name: Work From Hype
creators.bio:
Building my dream desk setup.

I believe you can learn a lot about someone based on the items they keep on their desk, myself included.

I started Work From Hype as a sort of video journal. Any time I added a new piece of gear to my desk, I made a video about it and posted it to YouTube. Over the past two years this video journal has evolved into a series of surreal memories, that cover everything from my favorite keyboard, to my struggles with staying focused.

If you want to know where the name came from, well yeah, it sounds like "Work From Home", but there's a bit more to it. The real reason why I put so much energy into my office and desk setup, is to try and get myself "hyped" to get to work every day. At some I discovered that I can overcome my personal struggles with focus if I'm excited, or "hyped" about what the place where I get work done.
